narr: An upper level low pressure system interacting with a stationary frontal system draped across southeast New York triggered copious amounts of showers and thunderstorms. An enhanced area of prolonged heavy rainfall over Delaware county produced a period of excessive runoff and some flash flooding of local roads.
ev: Flooding from East Brook was affecting county road CR-22.
